messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT · p99 latency spike detected on /v1/chat/completions (us-west-2) · p99=1350ms over 5m (threshold 1200ms) · paging eng-sre team :rotating_light:
Maya L.: Acked. I'm oncall. grabbing runbook now.
Arjun P.: On call — taking if Maya wants handoff. What customers affected?
Maya L.: No customer 5xxs seen, but conversational sessions are timing out for some flows. I see elevated tail latency in the per-model breakdown.
Priya S.: I can watch model side. Early signal looks like KV cache thrash on mistral-8x when sequence length > 1024. p95 ~ 380ms, p99 ~ 1350ms for mistral-8x; other models OK.
Sam T.: Autoscaler reported surge then an immediate throttle event at 12:05Z, might be hitting quota on burst capacity for that pool.
Elena R.: Confirmed: pool-g-chat-usw2 reached reserved-capacity limit, burst rejected. Related metric: pool.burst.rejects spiked to 42 in 1m.
Maya L.: Mitigation plan: 1) route a percentage of traffic for /v1/chat/completions to mistral-8x-quant fallback; 2) temporarily raise pool burst limit; 3) suppress noisy p99 alerts for 30m while we stabilize. Anyone object?
Arjun P.: +1 to routing split. How do we flip that safely?
Priya S.: I can create a canary route. Use the routing API:
```
POST /admin/v1/routing/split
{
  "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "policy": [
    {"model": "mistral-8x", "weight": 80},
    {"model": "mistral-8x-quant", "weight": 20}
  ]
}
```
Maya L.: Doing the split now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot started a config change: routing-split-1769999999 by Maya L. (in progress)
Maya L.: Split applied. Observing metrics...
Sam T.: I'm bumping pool burst limit from 10 -> 25 for pool-g-chat-usw2 via infra API, will monitor scaling events.
Elena R.: Done. Scaling events allowed again.
Priya S.: Early telemetry: p99 for mistral-8x down from 1350ms -> 820ms over 3m. p95 stable ~ 360ms. Quant fallback latency p99 ~ 720ms (ok).
Arjun P.: Nice. On alerting side I propose three quick changes: 1) change p99 alerting to be per-model-per-route (not global), 2) add a 3m rate-of-change suppression window to avoid flapping, 3) create a short-term squelch tag for this incident so paging stops for this signal while we stabilize.
Maya L.: Agree. Arjun, can you patch the alert rule? Keep a temp override for 30m and add a TODO to revert.
Arjun P.: Patching now. Rule name: latency.chat.completions.p99 -> split by model label and add suppress=3m.
```
PATCH /alerting/rules/latency.chat.completions.p99
{
  "group_by": ["route","model"],
  "squelch": {"duration": "3m", "change_pct": 20}
}
```
Arjun P.: Patch applied. Alert manager shows override active until 12:55Z.
Maya L.: Handing off to Arjun since I've got another page coming in from infra. Arjun, you're the primary now.
Arjun P.: Taking. I'll keep the thread and dashboard updates. Thanks Maya.
Priya S.: Re-checking memory/kv stats on nodes: there are a handful with elevated KV eviction counts. I'm going to roll a targeted kernel parameter tweak to improve cache retention for the serving runtime. Small restart per node, staged.
Sam T.: FYI doing a quick capacity audit — we'll add a scheduled bump to pool reservations for chat-critical from 50 -> 70 to avoid tight headroom during peak.
Elena R.: Filing a follow-up ticket for autoscaler tuning and burst policy: TICKET-3821 (https://rwinf.io/t/3821)
Maya L.: Customer impact summary for timeline: 12:02Z spike began; 12:08Z paging; 12:10Z routing split applied; 12:14Z burst limit increased; 12:18Z p99 reduced substantially; 12:25Z alerts squelched. No 5xxs observed, but elevated client perceived latency for a subset of long-seq sessions for ~15m.
Arjun P.: Will open incident postmortem and include the following action items: 1) permanent per-model-per-route p95/p99 rules (no more global p99), 2) dashboard tile for per-model KV eviction and cache hit rate, 3) autoscaler burst policy review (owner: Sam), 4) add alert suppression heuristics to runbook (owner: Maya).
Priya S.: I'll also add an evaluation to Redwood Optimize: recommend quantized fallback for long seq chat workloads and add a gating eval to catch KV thrash regressions.
Sam T.: Leaving notes in infra channel about scheduled reservation bump.
incident-bot: alert resolved for signal latency.chat.completions.p99 (resolved at 1770003510)
Elena R.: Closing timeline note in this thread. Please add any logs/links for postmortem.
Arjun P.: I'll assemble initial postmortem draft by EOD and attach dashboards + query snippets. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
